checks: Candidate verifier passes authenticated A/B image pins, exact code/gap/literal slices, reproducible csky objdump, caller conditionals and static loop fixtures. Manifest hashes agree.

Independent review confirms both loops first compare unsigned cursor against end, then perform 32-bit zero stores at four-byte increments until cursor is no longer below end. The embedded intervals yield 8,155 A stores and 22,979 B stores; each interval is aligned and half-open.

Both bodies preserve R0, save/restore R4-R6, and return through the saved R15. The source boundaries exclude the post-body zero halfwords, which remain unowned BKPTs, and separate the LRW literal spans.
The parent caller binding identifies A's conditional zero-result call and B's zero-result call followed by a branch into the caller's shared continuation.
limitations: Loop fixtures are static source-level evidence, not execution of privileged or physical memory effects. Writable DRAM, image selection/loading, aliases/cache effects and B DRAM-to-IRAM visibility remain unverified.
Other stage2 callees and complete payload ownership/closure remain outside scope. No canonical admission.
